releaseNotes: Added first-launch onboarding asking for Name, Email, Password, and Locked Default Currency.
Locked chosen currency across Home, Add Transaction, Accounts, Budgets, and Investments (editable later only in Settings).
Simplified Add Account: Cash asks only amount and optional label, while Bank and Card show tailored fields with no redundant currency selector.
Consolidated Profile, Currency, Privacy, Cloud Sync, Data Export, and Start Fresh into one clean Settings page and balanced the 5-tab navigation bar.
